dogecoin.text: @cryptocom @dogecoin @Shibtoken >TFW I sold 83% of my $SHIB on Saturday thinking it would crash with $DOGE :(

@AltcoinDailyio I heard about $SHIB in the fall and was like "I don't even want to buy $DOGE. Why would I buy an ERC-20 knockoff of it?" 

I did however buy $TEND as my #memecoin of choice since the team was active and was working on governance, NFTs, and a a game back then. 🙄

I think @elonmusk would rather improve a #ProofOfWork chain like $DOGE than use an existing chain that uses #ProofOfStake or other energy-efficient consensus schemes because with PoW, he can sell @Tesla solar panels / batteries and say "Use them to mine crypto for free!"
